chapter: Russell and Armstrong years, Goodman and the road
title: Pay at the Saratoga Club
summary: He made $60 a week while Goodman, as a leader downtown, made about $75.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What kind of money were you making to work in the Saratoga Club?
I mean, like how much? You know, things like this, this is very important because -
Well, it wasn't that much but it was a whole lot of money.
And how much do you think Benny Goodman was making down at the place where he was working downtown?
That's a whole lot of money.
Oh, I know, I know, 75 but I mean it was just $15 more than what you were making.
Yeah, the leader always gets more.
He was the leader at this time?
When he had the band downtown.
